# t

```ken
data Vec (a : Type) : Nat → Type where {
  VNil : Vec a Zero;
  VCons : (n : Nat) → a → Vec a n → Vec a (Suc n)
}

data Fin : Nat → Type where {
  FZero : (n : Nat) → Fin (Suc n);
  FSuc : (n : Nat) → Fin n → Fin (Suc n)
}

theorem t7 (a : Type) (n : Nat) (xs : Vec a n) (i : Fin n)
  : Equal (Vec a n) xs xs =
  match i {
    FZero m ↦ match xs { VCons _ x tail_xs ↦ Refl };
    FSuc m rest ↦ match xs { VCons _ x tail_xs ↦ Refl }
  }
```
